## Description

Giant polypodial amoeba (240–820 µm) with 6–49 nuclei and bipyramidal crystals; similar to *Amoeba
proteus* but with thinner pseudopods and many nuclei. It extends several pseudopods at once and
engulfs ciliates and algae.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 1 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A large plastic-membrane amoeba (~320 µm) with a long membrane ring; one of the most expensive beings
to simulate, so its drop weights are low.

## Not implemented yet

- Multinucleation is drawn but nuclei do not divide independently (plasmotomy).
- Crystals are not simulated.
- Sizes near 1 mm are not used (cost and plate size).

## Unique and shared mechanics

Shares the [plastic membrane and phagocytic cup](../../mechanics/feeding-and-phagocytosis.md) with *Amoeba*.
